page_title: ALM 0-3 OSA | Almeria v Osasuna 30/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+2' Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
89' Almeria take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
88' Osasuna show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.
85' The resulting set piece from Almeria is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
83' Alejandro Centelles Plaza (Almeria) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
81' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked.
79' Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes shows a yellow card to Marcos Pena (Almeria) for his blatant foul.
77' Juan Cruz goes off the pitch and Johan Mojica (Osasuna) comes on.
77' Substitution. Ante Budimir makes way for Raul Garcia (Osasuna).
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) will replace Jon Moncayola.
77' Here is a change. Lucas Robertone is going off and Pepe Mel gives the last tactical orders to Dion Lopy (Almeria).
75' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Alejandro Centelles Plaza (Almeria) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
73' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Osasuna comes to nothing.
71' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
67' The game has come to an end for Ruben Garcia. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Ruben Pena (Osasuna).
66' Almeria have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
64' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Almeria.
63' Pepe Mel has decided to substitute Jonathan Viera and he is replaced by Luka Romero (Almeria).
61' 0 - 3 GOAL! A cross into the box is headed down by Alejandro Catena and Iker Munoz (Osasuna) does brilliantly to get to the ball and fire home. 0:3.
57' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
56' Here's the change. Jose Manuel Arnaiz leaves the pitch and Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) comes on as a substitute.
53' Iker Munoz (Osasuna) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
51' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Lucas Robertone (Almeria).
51' Leo Baptistao (Almeria) has tested the patience of referee Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
48' Alejandro Centelles Plaza (Almeria) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Marko Milovanovic (Almeria) is replaced by Leo Baptistao.
46' Pepe Mel makes a half-time substitution. Adrian Embarba (Almeria) comes on in place of Sergio Arribas.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' Alejandro Centelles Plaza (Almeria) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
44' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes had an easy-decision to make.
43' 1:4 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
41' That was close. Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post.
39' Almeria can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
37' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) was quite harsh and Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
36' The corner is swung in but Almeria can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
33' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) gets free in the box and latches onto a good cross, but somehow he sends the ball narrowly wide of the right post from the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat.
30' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
28' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) had time and space on the edge of the box but sent his effort just over the bar.
26' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
24' Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows his whistle. Marc Pubill (Almeria) commits a foul after dangerous play.
22' Pepe Mel is forced to make a change. Aleksandar Radovanovic is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Marcos Pena (Almeria).
20' Aleksandar Radovanovic (Almeria) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee decides to stop play.
18' Juan Cruz (Osasuna) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
16' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Aleksandar Radovanovic (Almeria) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
14' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
12' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.
9' 0 - 2 Ante Budimir (Osasuna) slots the ball inside the back of the net and alters the score!
7' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Largie Ramazani (Almeria).
6' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
4' An attempted cross from Sergio Arribas (Almeria) is cleared.

2' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Jesus Areso slips the ball through to Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna), and he darts into the box to unleash a magnificent shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 0:1.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Almeria will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes.
